python3 - <<'PY'
import json,re
items=[json.loads(l) for l in open('items.jsonl')]
answers=[json.loads(l) for l in open('answers.jsonl')]
schema=json.load(open('answer_schema.json'))
assert len(answers)==len(items)
for i,(x,a) in enumerate(zip(items,answers),1):
 assert set(a)==set(schema['required']),i
 assert a['item_id']==x['item_id'],i
 assert re.fullmatch(schema['properties']['item_id']['pattern'],a['item_id']),i
 assert a['breathing'] in x['breathing_options'],i
 assert a['accent'] in x['accent_options'],i
 assert a['confidence'] in ('high','low'),i
 assert isinstance(a['note'],str),i
print(f'Validated {len(answers)} items: count, order, schema, and option validity pass.')
